outline.rationale: The user is new to both RL and LLMs but wants to read the key RLHF papers, so the outline builds from-scratch foundations (RL vocab, LLMs as policies) before RLHF-specific machinery. Node 1 motivates the whole endeavor. Nodes 2–3 supply the two prerequisite backgrounds separately (low overlap: one is RL, one is LLMs). Nodes 4–6 cover the three RLHF-specific pillars the papers assume — preference data collection, reward modeling, and policy optimization — kept conceptual (PPO high-level, KL role) per the confirmed depth, avoiding derivations. Node 7 integrates them into the SFT→RM→RL pipeline so the interplay is clear. Node 8 directly serves the stated goal by mapping to the actual papers and their vocabulary. Hands-on coding and deep RL theory are excluded as deprioritized.
